# The macro names that gocpp/rt.hpp defines with WinLibs' MinGW-w64 g++ 16.1.0 (x86_64-msvcrt-posix-seh,
# thread model posix, winpthreads: the compiler of the real Windows PC, also the MSYS2 mingw64 flavour), at -O0 and
# -O2. TestMacroList reads every file of this folder besides the compilers it finds, so the reserved names
# (internal/lower/cxx_macros.txt) cover compilers that are not installed where the test runs. To make
# a file for another compiler, run on a machine that has it (the rt/<version>/include folder is what
# "gocpp env GOCPPRUNTIME" prints, plus \include):
#
#	echo #include ^<gocpp/rt.hpp^> > rtinc.cpp
#	g++ -std=c++20 -fwrapv -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 -I <GOCPPRUNTIME>\include -dM -E rtinc.cpp
#
# and keep the names of the "#define NAME" lines, one a line, sorted. Then:
#	go test ./internal/cppgen -run TestMacroList -update
